versos.hebraico: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
controles.kjv: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
controles.livre: E no sétimo mês, ao primeiro do mês tereis santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis; vos será dia de soar as trombetas.

versos.hebraico: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
controles.livre: E oferecereis holocausto por cheiro suave ao SENHOR, um bezerro das vacas, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵ֥י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֖ים לָאָֽיִל׃

controles.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the ram,
controles.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
controles.livre: E a oferta de cereais deles, de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, três dízimas com cada bezerro, duas dízimas com cada carneiro,

versos.hebraico: וְעִשָּׂר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;
controles.kjv: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
controles.livre: E com cada um dos sete cordeiros, uma dízima;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
controles.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação, para reconciliar-vos:

versos.hebraico: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Além do holocausto do mês, e sua oferta de cereais, e o holocausto contínuo e sua oferta de cereais, e suas libações, conforme sua lei, por oferta de queima ao SENHOR em cheiro suave.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
controles.kjv: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
controles.livre: E no dez deste mês sétimo tereis santa convocação, e afligireis vossas almas: nenhuma obra fareis:

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; all without defect;
controles.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
controles.livre: E oferecereis em holocausto ao SENHOR por cheiro suave, um bezerro das vacas, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de ano; sem defeito os tomareis:

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,
controles.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
controles.livre: E suas ofertas de cereais, flor de farinha amassada com azeite, três dízimas com cada bezerro, duas dízimas com cada carneiro,

versos.hebraico: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:
controles.kjv: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
controles.livre: E com cada um dos sete cordeiros, uma dízima;

versos.hebraico: שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַכִּפֻּרִים֙ וְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
controles.kjv: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
controles.livre: Um bode macho por expiação: além da oferta das expiações pelo pecado, e do holocausto contínuo, e de suas ofertas de cereais, e de suas libações.

versos.hebraico: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם חַ֛ג לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

controles.web: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
controles.kjv: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days:
controles.livre: Também aos quinze dias do mês sétimo tereis santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis, e celebrareis solenidade ao SENHOR por sete dias;

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃

controles.web: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; all without defect;
controles.kjv: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
controles.livre: E oferecereis em holocausto, em oferta de queima ao SENHOR em cheiro suave, treze bezerros das vacas, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano: hão de ser sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָאַ֣יִל הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לִשְׁנֵ֖י הָאֵילִֽם׃

controles.web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,
controles.kjv: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
controles.livre: E as ofertas de cereais deles, de flor de farinha amassada com azeite, três dízimas com cada um dos treze bezerros, duas dízimas com cada um dos dois carneiros,

versos.hebraico: וְעִשָּׂרׄוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כְּבָשִֽׂים׃

controles.web: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
controles.kjv: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
controles.livre: E com cada um dos catorze cordeiros, uma dízima;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
controles.livre: E no segundo dia, doze bezerros das vacas, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
controles.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
controles.livre: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
controles.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, e sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
controles.livre: E no dia terceiro, onze bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.livre: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

controles.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, e sua presente e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
controles.livre: E no quarto dia, dez bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.livre: Suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

controles.kjv: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים תִּשְׁעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
controles.livre: E no quinto dia, nove bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.livre: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
controles.livre: E no sexto dia, oito bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
controles.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
controles.livre: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וּנְסָכֶֽיהָ׃פ

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
controles.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e suas libações.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שִׁבְעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
controles.livre: E no sétimo dia, sete bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃

controles.web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
controles.kjv: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
controles.livre: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃פ

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י עֲצֶ֖רֶת תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

controles.web: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no regular work;
controles.kjv: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
controles.livre: No oitavo dia tereis solenidade: nenhuma obra servil fareis:

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֥ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃

controles.web: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
controles.kjv: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
controles.livre: E oferecereis em holocausto, em oferta de queima de cheiro suave ao SENHOR, um novilho, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito;

versos.hebraico: מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם לַפָּ֨ר לָאַ֧יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
controles.kjv: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
controles.livre: Suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com o novilho, com o carneiro, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;

versos.hebraico: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
controles.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
controles.livre: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לְבַ֨ד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּלְמִנְחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶ֖ם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”
controles.kjv: These things ye shall do unto the Lord in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
controles.livre: Estas coisas oferecereis ao SENHOR em vossas solenidades, além de vossos votos, e de vossas ofertas livres, para vossos holocaustos, e para vossas ofertas de cereais, e para vossas libações e para vossas ofertas pacíficas.
